title: Paint palette

<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c99a55'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='p1' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b6b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc2233'/>

    <radialGradient id='p2' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#6bb5ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2255cc'/>

    <radialGradient id='p3' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffee66'/>

    <radialGradient id='p5' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#dd88ff'/>

      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffaa55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ee6600'/>

  <!-- palette body -->
  <path d='M20,55 C20,28 80,28 80,55 C80,80 62,88 50,88 C38,88 20,80 20,55 Z' fill='url(#wood)' stroke='#a87a3a' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='68' rx='9' ry='7.5' fill='#7a5520' stroke='#a87a3a' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- paint blobs -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='46' rx='8' ry='6.5' fill='url(#p1)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='46' rx='8' ry='6.5' fill='none' stroke='#ff9999' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='8' ry='6.5' fill='url(#p2)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='8' ry='6.5' fill='none' stroke='#99ccff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <ellipse cx='68' cy='46' rx='8' ry='6.5' fill='url(#p3)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='46' rx='8' ry='6.5' fill='none' stroke='#ffffaa' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <ellipse cx='62' cy='62' rx='7.5' ry='6' fill='url(#p4)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='62' rx='7.5' ry='6' fill='none' stroke='#aaffaa' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <ellipse cx='42' cy='58' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='url(#p5)'/>

  <ellipse cx='52' cy='72' rx='6.5' ry='5.5' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc99' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- brush -->
  <rect x='72' y='62' width='3' height='24' rx='1.5' fill='#b07840' transform='rotate(25 73 74)'/>
  <rect x='71' y='58' width='5' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0c0c0' transform='rotate(25 73 74)'/>
